org: Independent study — Russian Wikipedia arbitration elections
title: Wiki
governance
tagline: How is influence organised in a volunteer community of thousands? Nine years of election data, with voters renaming themselves along the way.

blocks.label: What I saw
blocks.text: Before the clustering there is an identity problem: 1,260 voters whose names change through rename logs, typos and time.

blocks.label: What I built
blocks.text: A dataset of 49,286 votes across 40 arbitration elections (2015–2024). Identities were matched through rename logs and edit distance; PCA and Ward clustering show five stable groups that persist year after year.

blocks.label: Result
blocks.text: The dataset is public on Kaggle. For completeness: I served as an arbitrator there myself (as Carn) and ended up inside one of the clusters.
